I didn't build this case. The unit and property method it needs aren't in this OpenFlowsheet version, and substituting something else is not allowed.

- **Unit:** the case needs an NTU heat exchanger (`HeatExchangerNTU`, `fs.heat_exchanger`). The effectiveness (0.55), area (70 m²) and U (170 W/m²/K) are its specified values. The only exchanger offered is `syn001.heat_exchanger`. It has no area, heat-transfer-coefficient or effectiveness parameters. Its only specification choices are hot outlet T, cold outlet T or duty. The case states none of those, so entering one would be a value the case doesn't give. The unit also has no pressure-change option, and the case sets `has_pressure_change: true`.
- **Property method:** the case uses an IDAES generic property package, `fs.hotside_properties` and `fs.coldside_properties`. It is an ideal aqueous apparent-species liquid-phase MEA/CO2/H2O model with the `MEA_solvent` property routines, Henry's law via N2O analogy, and the ionic species. The `list_models` output shows no property-method selection or electrolyte/MEA route. Only the synthetic `c1.*` and `syn001.*` model families are offered.
- **Components:** I didn't check this separately. `list_models` doesn't list components, so I haven't confirmed whether CO2, H2O and MEA are available.

I committed no revision and submitted no solve job.
